response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT sa.avg_pulse_rate, fm.mean_rate AS first_mean_rate FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(fk.avg_pulse_rate) AS average_pulse_rate, AVG(fk.avg_pulse_rate - fk.first_mean_rate) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM first_kept AS fk CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate
